🎬 Operation Fortune: Ruse de Guerre (2023) — Action, Comedy, Thriller
Orson Fortune is a highly skilled intelligence agent who is brought in to stop a dangerous technology from falling into the wrong hands. With the threat capable of causing serious global consequences, Fortune is forced to work with an unusual team while tracking down the billionaire arms dealer behind the operation.
To get close to their target, Fortune and his team use deception, undercover missions, and an unexpected Hollywood connection. Their mission becomes complicated as rival criminals and intelligence agencies enter the picture, turning a carefully planned operation into a fast-moving game of strategy and survival.
The film explores teamwork, deception, loyalty, power, and the unpredictable nature of espionage. Fortune may be a serious professional, but his unconventional methods and personality bring plenty of humor to the dangerous mission.
More than just a spy action movie, Operation Fortune mixes high-stakes missions with comedy and clever schemes, creating an entertaining story about a team willing to take unusual risks to save the day. 🔥
💬 If you were part of Fortune’s team, would you trust his unconventional methods? 👇
